headline: BTOB's Yook Sungjae opens 'Nine to Six' at 3.6%
sub: SBS office rom-com with Park Min-young peaks at 5.1%
source: Source: Nielsen Korea, via Korean media
caption:
BTOB's Yook Sungjae and Park Min-young's new drama 'Nine to Six' is off to a solid start!

The SBS office romance premiered Nov 25 with a 3.6% nationwide rating and 3.7% in the Seoul metropolitan area, peaking at 5.1%, according to Nielsen Korea. Sungjae plays Han Sun-woo, a new hire on a car company's legal team, opposite Park Min-young's deputy manager Kang I-ji. Episode 2 airs tonight (Nov 26) at 9 PM KST.

📌 Source: Nielsen Korea, via Korean media (MK Sports, Edaily, Sports Kyunghyang)
